next.reason: 1985: level 77 identifies 'noncontiguous working storage data items, noncontiguous linkage data items' (format 1 only); 66 for RENAMES (format 2 only); 88 for condition-names, 'used only as described by format 3'. §2023:13.18.33.4 GR2 keeps 66 and 77 and adds 'noncontiguous local storage data items' to 77, and 88 now also defines 'criteria to be used to validate a data item' and 'may be used only as described by the condition-name format or the validation format'. §2023:8.5.1.3.2 restates the 66/77/88 assignments. The 88 restriction is loosened by the added validation format.
